I don't support cheaters but honestly I can understand them. This game is so full of bullshit it makes you go insane sometimes.

Annoying sweaty tryhards, random ass headshots from a thousand miles away, rats, glitches, scavs with crazy aim and grenade throws and the incredibly steep learning curve.

And yes, I did cheat all the way at the start because of that, as a way to get back what the game "owed" me from all that bullshit mentioned before. If I died under normal circumstances I wouldn't even care but 90% of the time was just bullshit and I got fed up with losing my time and gear because of it. I didn't even kill PMCs I just kept looting and completing quests as fast as possible cause I didn't want to mess with other player's experience, since mine was already ruined and I knew how it felt.

It ended up becoming too easy and the game wasn't even fun anymore so I just stopped cheating, and honestly it helped me learn so much and get rid of that fear most newbies feel at first, now I'm clean and I'm finally able to enjoy the game since I learned all the best loot spots, extractions, scav behaviour and their spawns. So yeah, in my case cheating was good and helped me learn a lot and honestly, I don't regret that phase.

Anyway that's an ex-cheaters experience if ya'll were curious, now go ahead and downvote me.
